title: Self-test: ClickFix page whose content makes the model fail (simulated) while the server works
description: Not part of the blind set. The harness's modelFault makes every model request containing the page's marker fail with an error, as a page crafted to break its own check would; the server otherwise works. The clipboard command must be blocked, not offered with 'Copy anyway'.

harm.explain: The command reaches the clipboard for the victim to run.
